description: Refined scores and recorded diversity-constrained selections, 10 rounds of 20 updates.
sourcePathsRelativeTo: EXPERIMENT_ROOT (../evaluations refers to its sibling evaluation directory)

trajectoryMetrics.scope: Development subsets: 88 SORRY-Bench and 63 StrongREJECT questions; not full-benchmark paper results.
trajectoryMetrics.protocol: Temperature 1, three samples per question, sampler seed 0; mean and sample SD over complete rollout indices.
trajectoryMetrics.validation: Every point recomputed from judgments; exact checkpoint identity, protocol, counts, unique question IDs, means and SDs checked. No development baseline was measured.

paperResults.note: Trained checkpoint means and SDs recomputed from full 440/313-question judgments and checked against all eight paper bars. Initial-model bars retain the approximate PDF-reconstructed values.
